nodes.text:
Prelate Vaelen kneels beside the open crystal doors of the gilded carillon. For the first time in years, her raw fingers are not turning the brass key; they rest quietly on the empty velvet cushion where her daughter's spirit lay.

"Forty-two times I re-cut the wax," she whispers, her voice hoarse from weeping. "I told myself I was keeping her alive, when all I was keeping was my own refusal to say goodbye. Until you sang the last line, I had forgotten how gentle her real voice sounded."

She reaches into her vestments and presses a clear phial of memory-tallow into your hand, then nods toward the crescent disc gleaming in the carillon's mainspring. "Take the Seal of the Waxing Moon, {player.name}. If you unseal the Cradle of the First Architect below, do not let him trap the world in the same cage I built for my child."

choices.text: She rested knowing she was loved, Vaelen.
I'll carry the Moon Seal to the gate.

nodes.text: Prelate Vaelen traces the silent brass comb of the carillon. "Go with the Wayfarers' blessing, {player.name}. I will begin unsealing the ledgers in the stacks, one soul at a time."
